description.text: The other fourth expansion of the Sun & Moon series, released together with Awakened Heroes on 15 September 2017, in which the Ultra Beasts arrived as Pokémon-GX. Ultradimensional Beasts holds Nihilego-GX and Guzzlord-GX, with Gyarados-GX and Alolan Exeggutor-GX. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 50, followed by full-art Super Rare Pokémon-GX and Lusamine, rainbow Hyper Rare Pokémon-GX, and gold Ultra Rare Wishful Baton, Counter Energy and Water Energy. In English most of its cards came out in Crimson Invasion in November 2017.
